data_fields.name: pad_radius_px
data_fields.donor_constant: directionPadSize / 2; directionPadSize = min(w,h)/4 or roundToInt(dpi) when DPI known

best_idea: A fixed-anchor thumb pad that clamps its knob to a radius and reads four overlapping 135-degree sectors (a diagonal sets two flags), plus a ring-by-ring lock-on that picks the smallest facing turn in the first ring that holds a target.
decision_why: Keep the ring-first lock-on and overlapping stick sectors, add the dead zone the donor lacks on the pad path, and move the pick into src/fight/target.ts so the engine owns many-on-one choice; the client only shows the suggestion. Licence is restricted, so shape only.
acceptance: On a 375-wide phone, dragging the pad diagonally walks the hero diagonally and holding a direction walks one tile per game step; a server test asserts the lock-on returns the hostile with the smallest facing turn in the first ring that holds one (non-talk first) and rejects an engage on a tile the lock-on did not offer.
